prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent PNG fox miniature token for a square-grid tabletop RPG, legible at 64px and distinguishable at 48px.
Primary request: create a NEW fox, with unmistakably light fox proportions and a large bushy tail.
Input images: Image 1 is the original ToME fox sprite, used only for identity: a russet-brown pointed-faced fox with dark lower legs and a prominent curved bushy tail. Image 2 is the accepted wolf token, used only for camera, painted miniature style, upper-left light, neutral grey-brown thin round base and framing. Do not reproduce the wolf's body, head or crouched pose.
Subject: one agile russet fox viewed from a steep high angle, on four slim legs, a narrow pointed muzzle, tall triangular ears, dark lower legs, and one very large fluffy sweeping tail with a restrained cream tip. Small cream areas under the muzzle and chest, warm copper and brown coat planes. The fox turns in a lively compact arc on the base; its head is slightly angled toward the lower left and its large tail curls around its far side, with the head, ears and tail silhouette clearly separate. Keep the face sharper, the torso slimmer, and the tail proportionally much larger than the wolf. Do not make a wolf painted orange.
Style/medium: hand-painted carved tabletop miniature with matte finish and broad dry-brushed fur facets. Strong readable volumes and restrained natural colours, no photoreal hair filaments.
Composition: square canvas. Match the neutral disc's size, centered framing, high viewpoint and thin rim to Image 2. Fit one entire animal and one full disc. The fox should use most of the disc's inner area; all ears, paws and every part of the tail remain strictly inside the outer circular rim with a narrow visible boundary. Do not add a large unused area around a tiny creature.
Lighting: soft light from upper left; short contact shading contained on the disc only.
Backdrop: real fully transparent alpha outside the base, with no painted transparency checkerboard, no solid backdrop, no external cast shadow.
Constraints: no faction colours on the base, no colored ring, no halo, no symbols, no lettering, no rank marks, no grass or rocks, no other animals, no costume, no collar, no text, no watermark.
reference_roles: original ToME fox sprite; species identity only
accepted wolf miniature; high-angle camera, painted material, lighting, neutral base and framing only
review: Pointed narrow face, slender dark legs and a disproportionately large cream-tipped russet tail distinguish the fox from both wolf variants. Whole figure remains within the neutral circular base. Broad painted fur shapes match the approved family; one far rear leg is naturally occluded. Full miniature reviewed, small-size integration remains for parent.
image_processing: Copied original generated PNG without pixel edits, resizing, background extraction or alpha modification.
